pub mod util {
    pub fn free() {}
}

pub struct Builder;

impl Builder {
    pub fn finish(&self) {}
}

pub trait Install {
    fn install(&self);
}

impl Install for Builder {
    fn install(&self) {}
}

pub fn caller(builder: &Builder) {
    util::free();
    builder.finish();
    builder.install();
}

pub fn closure_caller() {
    let later = || util::free();
    later();
}
